grammar_list:
================================================================================
VCE JAPANESE: COMPREHENSIVE & SYSTEMATIC GRAMMAR MASTER LIST
================================================================================

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1. VERB FORMS & CONJUGATIONS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- Plain Form (Dictionary Form / Ru-form / U-form / Irregular verbs)
- Negative Form (Nai-form)
- Past Form (Ta-form)
- Past Negative Form (Nakatta-form)
- Polite Form (Masu / Masen / Mashita / Masendeshita)
- Te-form (Conjunctive / Linking)
- Tara-form (Conditional)
- Volitional Form (Let's / Shall we - V-o/you/e-ou/you)
- Tentative / Presumptive Form (Darou / Deshou)
- Conjunctive Form & Parallel (~te, ~de, ~ku, ~ni)
- Stem Form (Renyoukei / Base for attachments)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
2. DESIRES, OPINIONS, ABILITIES & PREFERENCES
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[Desire & Intent]
- verb stem form + たいです / たいと思っています (meaning: want to + verb)
- verb stem form + たくないです / たくなかったです / たかったです (meaning: do/did not want to + verb)
- verb stem form + たがります / たがっている (meaning: be eager to + verb)
- verb dictionary form + つもりです (meaning: intend to + verb)
- verb dictionary form + ほうがいいです / verb present negative form (or ない form) + ほうがいいです (meaning: had better / had better not + verb)
- verb/adjective (plain form) + ことは + adjective (meaning: it is [adjective] that... / to do [verb] is [adjective], e.g., 行くことは楽しいです)

[Ability & Skills]
- noun + ができます / verb dictionary form + ことができます (meaning: can do / can + verb)
- noun + が上手です / 下手です (meaning: be good at / bad at + noun)
- verb dictionary form + ことが上手です / 下手です (meaning: be good at / bad at + verbing)
- verb stem form + やすい / づらい / にくい (meaning: easy / hard to + verb)

[Preferences & Needs]
- noun + が好きです / 大好きです / きらいです (meaning: like / love / dislike + noun)
- verb dictionary form + ことが好きです / ことが好きじゃないです / ことがきらいです (meaning: like / do not like / dislike to + verb)
- noun + がほしいです (meaning: want + noun)
- noun + がいります (meaning: need + noun)
- noun + が分かります (meaning: understand + noun)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
3. TENSE, ASPECT & ACTION PHASES
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[Ongoing & State]
- verb て form + います (meaning: is, am, are + verbing / have been + verbing)
- verb て form + いました (meaning: was, were + verbing)

[Process & Movement]
- verb stem form + はじめました (meaning: started to + verb)
- verb stem form + おえました (meaning: finished + verbing)
- verb stem form + に来ます / 行きます (meaning: come / go to + verb)
- verb dictionary form + ことがはじまります / ていきます (meaning: movement-associated actions)
- verb dictionary form + てしまいます (meaning: completion / regret)

[Trial & Experience]
- verb て form + みます / 試してみます (meaning: try to + verb)
- verb て form + みたいです (meaning: want to try to + verb)
- past positive form + ことがあります (meaning: have/has the experience of + verbed)
- にいったことがあります (meaning: have been to)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
4. PERMISSION, PROHIBITION & OBLIGATION
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- verb て form + もいいです (meaning: be allowed to / may + verb)
- verb て form + もいいですか (meaning: Can I + verb?)
- verb て form + はいけません / てはだめです (meaning: be not allowed to / must not + verb)
- verb present negative form (without い at the end) + なければなりません / くてはいけません (meaning: must / have to + verb)
- verb present negative form (without い at the end) + なければなりませんでした (meaning: had to + verb)
- verb present negative form (without い at the end) + なくてもいいです / なくてもよかったです (meaning: do not have to / did not have to + verb)
- verb dictionary form / verb present negative form (or ない form) + べきです / べきじゃないです / べきでした (meaning: should / should not / should have + verb)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
5. REQUESTS, INSTRUCTIONS & INVITATIONS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- verb stem form + ましょう (meaning: Let's + verb)
- verb stem form + ましょうか (meaning: Shall we + verb?)
- verb stem form + ませんか (meaning: Why don't you + verb?)
- verb て form + ください (meaning: Please + verb)
- verb present negative form (or ない form) + いでください (meaning: Please don't + verb)
- verb て form + くださいませんか / いただけませんか (meaning: Would you be able to + verb?)
- verb stem form + かた (meaning: how to + verb + noun)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
6. COMPARISON & DEGREE
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- noun + のほうが noun + より i-adjective / na-adjective (meaning: A is more adjective than B)
- noun + は noun + ほど adjective (negative) (meaning: A is not as adjective as B)
- noun + と noun + とちがいます / とにています (meaning: A is different from / similar to B)
- noun + は一番 i-adjective / na-adjective (meaning: A is the most adjective)
- stem + すぎます (meaning: verb/adjective too much)
- noun + じょう (meaning: more than A)
- (plain form) らしい形容詞 → 副詞 (い → く) (meaning: adjective to adverb conversion)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
7. MODIFIERS, CLAUSES & NOUN LINKING
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[Relative Clauses (関係節)]
- Relative Clause: plain form verb/adjective + noun (e.g., 食べた人, 友だちが買った車) (meaning: relative clause where a plain-form clause modifies a following noun, translating to 'who / which / that...')
- noun + の + noun (meaning: A in B)
- noun + という + noun (meaning: A called B)
- noun + などの + noun (meaning: A such as B)
- verb dictionary form + ための + noun / verb dictionary form + ために (meaning: noun to verb / in order to + verb)

[Time Clauses & Sequence]
- dictionary form / past positive form + とき (meaning: when...)
- plain form + あいだ (meaning: while / during...)
- verb dictionary form / noun + のまえに / past positive form + あとで (meaning: before / after...)
- verb て form + から (meaning: after doing... / since)
- verb stem form + ながら (meaning: while + verbing)
- noun + から + noun + まで (meaning: from A to B)

[Listing & Coordination]
- past positive form + り、past positive form + りします (meaning: listing actions / verb1 and verb2)
- verb て form + verb / [verb て form, ..., verb て form] + verb (meaning: sequential actions and connecting clauses within a sentence, e.g., 学校に行って、テストを受ける)
- i-adjective + くて + i-adjective / na-adjective + で + na-adjective (meaning: joining adjectives / adjective and adjective)
- noun + だけでなく + noun + も (meaning: not only A but also B)
- noun + のほかに、 (meaning: other than A)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
8. COMPLEX SENTENCES, REASONS & HYPOTHESES
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[Reason & Cause]
- sentence + から / ので + sentence (meaning: sentence A because sentence B)
- plain form + からです (meaning: It is because + sentence)
- noun + のおかげで、 (meaning: thanks to noun)

[Condition & Concession]
- past positive form + ら + sentence (meaning: sentence A if sentence B)
- ba-form + sentence (meaning: sentence A if sentence B)
- sentence + でも / verb て form + も + sentence (meaning: sentence A even if sentence B)
- sentence + が / のに / けれど + sentence (meaning: sentence A but sentence B)
- sentence + けど + sentence (meaning: A, but B)

[Conjecture, Hearsay & Appearance]
- plain form + そうです / らしいです (meaning: They say that + sentence / hearsay)
- verb stem form / adjective stem form + そうです (meaning: It looks like + adjective/verb / appearance)
- plain form + ようです / らしいです (meaning: resemblance / conjecture)
- plain form + かもしれません (meaning: may / might + verb)
- plain form + でしょう / だろう (meaning: probability / conjecture)
- noun + は noun + みたいです / noun + のように (meaning: A is like B)

[Thoughts & Quotations]
- plain form + と + person + は思います (meaning: person + think + sentence)
- plain form + と + person + は言います (meaning: person + say + sentence)
- plain form + のです / んです (meaning: explanation / reason)
- plain form + し (meaning: listing reasons / addition)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
9. PARTICLES, CONNECTORS & IDIOMS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[Particles]
- は, が, の, に, へ, を, で, と, や, か, も, より, など, ほか (meaning: particles such as topic, subject, possessive, direction, object, location, etc.)

[Connectors & Transition Words]
- たとえば、 (meaning: For example)
- だから、 (meaning: Therefore)
- しかし、 (meaning: However)
- また、 (meaning: Also)
- そして、 (meaning: And / In addition)
- 一方、 (meaning: On the other hand)
- noun + によると、 (meaning: According to noun)
- noun + として + noun (meaning: A as B)

[Idioms & Fixed Expressions]
- noun + をたのしみにしています (meaning: look forward to noun)
- noun + は + noun + にきょうみがあります (meaning: noun is interested in noun)
- noun + は + noun + としてしられています (meaning: noun is known as noun)
- noun + は + noun + でゆう名です (meaning: noun is famous for noun)
- country + じん (meaning: people from the country)
- person + が + verb dictionary form + のをてつだう (meaning: help person to verb-dictionary form)
- noun + には + noun + があります / います (meaning: noun has noun)
grading_criteria:
**【VCE Official Grading Criteria (Section 3 Writing) & Mark Ranges (out of 20)】**
- Criterion 1: Content (Relevance, breadth, and depth)
 	* Relevance to the task, comprehensiveness, sophistication, and logical development (sequencing) within and across paragraphs.
- Criterion 2: Language (Accuracy, range, and appropriateness of vocabulary and grammar)
 	* Accuracy and variety (range) of vocabulary and grammar, appropriateness for the context/audience/text type, and cohesion/flow.

- Mark Ranges & Expected Qualities:
 	* 19–20 Marks (Rank 1 / Gold Star ⭐):
 	 	Original interpretation, highly effective structure and development. Flawless register, excellent grammatical/lexical control, and accurate kanji/kana usage.
 	* 16–18 Marks (Rank 2 / Orange Star ⭐):
 	 	Skillful integration of relevant information, effective structure and development. Accurate and complex grammatical structures.
 	* 13–15 Marks (Rank 3 / Green Star ⭐):
 	 	Conveys and successfully integrates relevant information. Appropriate range of vocabulary and grammar with mostly accurate script.
 	* 10–12 Marks (Rank 4 / Purple Star ⭐):
 	 	Relevant information and ideas presented. Basic features with safe vocabulary and standard sentence structures.
 	* 4–9 Marks (Rank 5 / Red Star ⭐):
 	 	Partial information provided. Inconsistent structure. Limited accuracy in vocabulary, grammar, and kanji/kana.
 	* 3 Marks or Below (No Star / Re-attempt Required):
 	 	Little or no awareness of task requirements.
